text: In 210 BC, he set out on another tour of the country and fell ill on the road.
spoken: In two hundred and ten B.C., he set out on another tour of the country and fell ill on the road.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po nazwie, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)
pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
